data.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-check-story-handoff.sh before the script exists (RED).

## Test Cases
1. Predecessor verifier JSON with P1=PASS -> exits 0 (successor dispatch permitted)
2. Predecessor verifier JSON with P1=FAIL -> exits 1 with structured error {predecessor_story, verdict, reason}
3. Predecessor verifier JSON with P1=BLOCKED -> exits 1
4. Predecessor verifier JSON with P1=INCONCLUSIVE -> exits 1
5. No predecessor verifier JSON found (file absent) -> exits 2 (missing verdict error)
6. Malformed predecessor verifier JSON -> exits 2

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-story-handoff.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-check-story-handoff.sh

## Testing Mode
RED
data.title: T1: RED — Write test suite for check-story-handoff.sh
